Refactored the public API into a real contract by adding [IntHeap.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/011_binary_heap/IntHeap.java:1). `MinHeap` is now a final compatibility-facing adapter that implements that interface in [MinHeap.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/011_binary_heap/MinHeap.java:1), while the older names like `insertKey`, `getMin`, `extractMin`, and `isFull` are explicitly marked as legacy wrappers. That makes the intended API surface clearer and separates it from backwards-compatible aliases.

I also added bulk insertion through `addAll(int...)` and cleaned up the internal semantics in [IntBinaryHeap.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/011_binary_heap/IntBinaryHeap.java:41), including renaming the internal fixed-buffer check to `isAtCapacity` so it no longer pretends the dynamic heap is truly “full”. The tests in [MinHeapTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/011_binary_heap/MinHeapTest.java:30) now exercise the heap through the new `IntHeap` abstraction as well as the legacy API.
